March – Oct. 1981 1 st March 1981 – five years after SCS had been removed, a second hunger strike began. This hunger strike was led by Bobby Sands – the PIRA inmates’ Commanding Officer. Unlike the previous hunger strike, this time prisoners would join the hunger strike at intervals – not all starting at the same time. This would make the hunger strike last longer and maximise its impact. However, although the hunger strike gained huge publicity and the sympathy of many in the Nationalist community, it did not change the British government’s policy. “ Let me make one point about the hunger strike in the Maze prison. There can be no political justification for murder or any other crime. The government will never concede political status to the hunger strikers .” The words of the then British PM Margaret Thatcher.
